blurb: Pierpoint Landing runs a fleet of three boats offering half-day, full-day, overnight, and multi-day fishing trips targeting calico bass, sand bass, yellowtail, rockfish, tuna, and more. Trips include open-party day trips, private charters, and extended overnight or multi-day adventures. They provide live bait, tackle, and have experienced captains and crew.
